rv.q: You'll be charmed, I'm sure, if you go see this show.
The tone of the show mixes naïveté with worldliness, as it should, for the combination gives the show its basic charm.
This 'Charlie Brown' should have great appeal to the small set who will discover or rediscover simple life lessons and the wonders of Peanuts characters.
In trying to literalize Schulz's world, Unger and company have killed the joke.
